title: Church Order in Zarahemla
summary: After speaking to the people of the church in Zarahemla, Alma ordains priests and elders by laying on his hands. Repentant nonmembers are baptized and received into the church. Members who do not repent and humble themselves are rejected, and their names are blotted out. They begin to establish the order of the church in Zarahemla.
characters: repentant people who did not belong to the church
church members who did not repent and humble themselves

explicit_facts.text: After speaking to the people of the church in Zarahemla, Alma ordained priests and elders by laying on his hands to preside and watch over the church.
People who did not belong to the church and repented of their sins were baptized unto repentance and received into the church.
Church members who did not repent and humble themselves before God were rejected, and their names were blotted out.
They began to establish the order of the church in Zarahemla.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Alma places his hands on those he ordains.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance and number of the people.
The physical setting of the ordinations.

narration.text: And thus they began to establish the order of the church in the city of Zarahemla.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verses report distinct actions; do not depict them as simultaneous.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent individual identities, reactions, or dialogue.
Do not depict a specific baptismal method or a name-blotting action not described as visibly occurring.

title: Gathering, Fasting, and Prayer
summary: The word of God is available to all, and the children of God are commanded to gather often, fast, and pray for those who do not know God.

explicit_facts.text: None were deprived of the privilege of assembling to hear the word of God.
The children of God were commanded to gather often and join in fasting and mighty prayer for the welfare of the souls of those who knew not God.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The children of God gather together.
unspecified_visual_details: The specific gathering place, participants, and manner of fasting or prayer.

narration.text: none were deprived of the privilege of assembling themselves together
join in fasting and mighty prayer

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The prayer for people who do not know God is not a depiction of those people as present.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a divine or supernatural figure in response to prayer.

title: Alma Goes to Gideon
summary: After making the regulations, Alma departs from the church in Zarahemla and goes east of the river Sidon into the valley of Gideon. A city called Gideon had been built there and named after the man slain by Nehor with a sword.

explicit_facts.text: After making the regulations, Alma departed from the church in Zarahemla and went east of the river Sidon into the valley of Gideon.
A city called Gideon had been built in the valley of Gideon.
The city and valley were called Gideon after the man slain by Nehor with a sword.

unspecified_visual_details: Alma's route, whether he crosses the river, and the appearance of the valley and city are not specified.

title: Alma Teaches in Gideon
summary: Alma goes to the valley of Gideon and begins declaring the word of God to the church established there.

explicit_facts.text: Alma went and began to declare the word of God to the church established in the valley of Gideon.
His declaration was according to the testimony of Jesus Christ, the Son of God, who should come to redeem his people from their sins.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Alma addresses members of the church in the valley.
